CreateApp.summary: Create a whiteboard application and obtain the AppID while setting the application name.

schema.description: The application name set by the user in the console when creating a whiteboard application. It must consist of 1 to 32 Chinese characters, English letters, digits, or underscores.

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Return Result.

CreateApp.title: Create Whiteboard Application
CreateApp.description:
# How-To

- This API is used to create a whiteboard application.
- The Interactive Whiteboard console has not been officially published yet. Please perform related operations for whiteboard applications through the Interactive Whiteboard server software development kit (SDK).

# queries per second (QPS) Limit
The QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your service. Call the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS Limit](~~342798~~).

CreateWhiteBoard.summary: Create a whiteboard document and obtain the document identifier DocKey.

Unique Identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Return Result.

DocKey.description: Document identifier consisting of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits.

DescribeApps.summary: Perform a paged query to retrieve whiteboard application information under an Alibaba Cloud account.

schema.description: Unique Identifier of the whiteboard application. If this parameter is empty, all application IDs are queried by default. To obtain an AppID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).

Whiteboard application status. If this parameter is empty, all statuses are queried by default. Valid values:  

- **1**: Enabled.  
- **2**: Disabled.
Page number to query. If this parameter is empty, page 1 is queried by default.
Number of entries displayed per page. If this parameter is empty, 10 entries are displayed by default.

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Return Result.

TotalPage.description: Total number of pages of applications.

items.description: Data of the application details list.

AppID.description: The Unique Identifier of the whiteboard application.

AppName.description: The Name of the whiteboard application.

Status.description:
Whiteboard application status. Valid values:  

- **1**: Enabled.  
- **2**: Disabled.

CallbackUrl.description: The webhook address URL of the whiteboard application.

DomainNames.description: List of valid domain names. Multiple domain names are separated by commas (,).

CreateTime.description: The Creation Time of the whiteboard application.

CallbackType.description: The callback types of the whiteboard application. Multiple types are separated by commas (,). The value "all" indicates that all callbacks are configured.

DescribeWhiteBoardRecordings.summary: Perform a paged query to retrieve the list of enabled whiteboard recordings and their operation sequences.

schema.description: The Unique Identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).
The Unique Identifier of the whiteboard document. To obtain the DocKey, see [CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~).
The page number to query. If this parameter is empty, the default value is 1.
The number of items displayed per page. If this parameter is empty, the default value is 10.

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Return Result.

AppID.description: Unique Identifier of the whiteboard application.

DocKey.description: Unique Identifier of the whiteboard document.

RecordId.description: Unique Identifier of the whiteboard recording session.

UserId.description: User ID of the user who created the whiteboard recording.

OperateList.description: List of operations performed during the whiteboard recording.

items.description:
Whiteboard recording operation in the format: operate@UNIX timestamp. The value of operate is as follows:

- **start**: Start whiteboard recording.
- **stop**: Stop whiteboard recording.
- **pause**: Pause whiteboard recording.
- **resume**: Resume whiteboard recording.

OpenWhiteBoard.title: Open whiteboard document
OpenWhiteBoard.description:
# How-To

- Before invoking this API, you must have already called [CreateApp](~~204234~~) and [CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~) to create a whiteboard application and a whiteboard document.
- This API will send user authentication callback and user information callback requests to your server to retrieve user permissions and basic user information. Ensure that the webhook address of your application is correctly configured.

# Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 200 queries per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your service. Call this API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342798~~).

Unique Identifier of the whiteboard document. To obtain a DocKey, see [CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~).
The Unique Identifier of the whiteboard recording session. To obtain the RecordId, see [StartWhiteBoardRecording](~~253300~~).

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Return Result.
